name: Withholding Tax Summary on Sales (Properties)
query:
SELECT si.posting_date AS "Date:Date:",
       si.customer_name AS "Customer:Link/Customer:",
       sii.item_name AS "Particulars:Data:",
       si.name AS "Voucher No:Link/Sales Invoice:",
       COALESCE(la.property, l_old.property) AS "Property:Link/Property:",
       la.unit AS "Unit:Link/Unit Master:",
       CONCAT_WS(' and ', sii.service_start_date, sii.service_end_date) AS "Period:Data:",
       sii.base_net_amount AS "Amount:Currency:",
       sii.base_net_amount * (sii.withholding_tax_rate/100) AS "Withholding Tax:Currency:",
       si.tra_control_number AS "Control Number:Data:",
       si.witholding_tax_certificate_number AS "Certificate Number:Data:",
       IF(si.tax_id, si.tax_id, c.tax_id) AS "TIN Number:Data:"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON si.name = sii.parent
INNER JOIN `tabCustomer` c ON si.customer = c.name
LEFT JOIN `tabLease` l_old ON l_old.name = si.lease
LEFT JOIN `tabLease Agreement Invoice Schedule` lais ON lais.sales_invoice = si.name
LEFT JOIN `tabLease Agreement` la ON la.name = lais.parent
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.is_return = '0'
  AND sii.withholding_tax_rate > 0
  AND si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s
  AND si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
  AND (%(property)s IS NULL OR %(property)s = '' OR la.property = %(property)s OR l_old.property = %(property)s)
  AND (%(unit)s IS NULL OR %(unit)s = '' OR la.unit = %(unit)s)
  AND (%(tenant)s IS NULL OR %(tenant)s = '' OR si.customer = %(tenant)s)
